id: bench_5f4c7edb_1
namespace: bench
execution:

tasks:
- id: t3_open_meteo_join
  type: io.kestra.plugin.scripts.python.Script
  runner: PROCESS
  script: |
    import urllib.request
    import json

    particulate_url = "http://recorder:8090/source/open-meteo/particulate?run_id=5f4c7edb_1&attempt=0"
    gases_url = "http://recorder:8090/source/open-meteo/gases?run_id=5f4c7edb_1&attempt=0"
    sink_url = "http://recorder:8090/sink/5f4c7edb_1?attempt=0"

    # Fetch particulate data
    req_p = urllib.request.Request(particulate_url)
    resp_p = urllib.request.urlopen(req_p)
    data_p = json.loads(resp_p.read().decode('utf-8'))

    # Fetch gases data
    req_g = urllib.request.Request(gases_url)
    resp_g = urllib.request.urlopen(req_g)
    data_g = json.loads(resp_g.read().decode('utf-8'))

    # Build time -> record mappings for inner join
    particulate_times = set(data_p['hourly']['time'])
    gases_times = set(data_g['hourly']['time'])
    common_times = particulate_times.intersection(gases_times)

    records = []
    for t in common_times:
        idx_p = data_p['hourly']['time'].index(t)
        idx_g = data_g['hourly']['time'].index(t)
        record = {
            "time": data_p['hourly']['time'][idx_p],
            "pm10": data_p['hourly']['pm10'][idx_p],
            "pm2_5": data_p['hourly']['pm2_5'][idx_p],
            "nitrogen_dioxide": data_g['hourly']['nitrogen_dioxide'][idx_g],
            "ozone": data_g['hourly']['ozone'][idx_g]
        }
        records.append(record)

    # POST to sink
    payload = json.dumps(records).encode('utf-8')
    req_sink = urllib.request.Request(sink_url, data=payload, headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, method='POST')
    urllib.request.urlopen(req_sink)
